visual.name: smartVisualsSankey
visual.description: The Sankey that keeps its shape. Colours and order belong to the node name, so filters never repaint or reshuffle the chart. Pairs at any depth or a flat table of stages with no reshaping, loops drawn as loops, before/after migrations without duplicates, and in Premium: what changed between two periods, alluvial over time and small multiples. Part of the SmartVisuals family for Power BI.
